description: Quick EMPTY-HANDED palm strike in place. The body keeps facing exactly the SAME direction as the starting frame for every frame: never turn, never rotate the torso toward the camera or away from it. Draw the right hand back to the hip, step slightly forward, thrust the right open palm forward at chest height in the facing direction, hold a beat, recoil to the relaxed stance. The hands hold NOTHING: no knife, no dagger, no weapon, no talisman. No motion lines, no slash arcs, no effects. HEADLESS body ending at a short neck stump: never draw a head, and keep both hands below the shoulders. Feet stay on the same spot. Same outfit, proportions and pixel scale.
